"'''Kostas'''" '''Papanikolaou''' ({{langx|el|Κωνσταντίνος "Κώστας" Παπανικολάου}}; born 31 July 1990), nicknamed "'''Air Pap'''", is a Greek professional [[basketball]] player and the [[captain (sports)|team captain]] for [[Olympiacos B.C.|Olympiacos]] of the [[Greek Basket League]] (GBL) and the [[EuroLeague]]. Standing at 2.04 [[Metre|m]] (6'8 {{1/2}}"),[http://www.euroleague.net/competition/players/showplayer?pcode=001255#!careerstats PAPANIKOLAOU, KOSTAS HEIGHT: 2.04.]{{cite web|title=Olympiacos officially announced Papanikolaou|url=http://www.eurohoops.net/euroleague/172911/olympiacos-officially-announced-papanikolaou|work=Eurohoops.net|date=20 January 2016|access-date=20 January 2016}} he plays at the [[small forward]] position. He is widely considered among the best defensive players in European basketball.{{Cite web |date=2018-05-08 |title=EuroLeague Best Defender by Eurohoops: Κώστας Παπανικολάου, Greeks do it better |url=https://www.eurohoops.net/el/euroleague-el-2/671268/euroleague-best-defender-by-eurohoops-kostas-papanikolaou-greeks-do-it-better/ |access-date=2022-03-18 |website=Eurohoops |language=el}} A back-to-back EuroLeague champion with Olympiacos in [[2011–12 Euroleague|2012]] and [[2012–13 Euroleague|2013]], Papanikolaou was the [[EuroLeague Finals Top Scorer]] in [[2012 EuroLeague Final Four|2012]] and won the [[EuroLeague Rising Star]] award in [[2012–13 Euroleague#Rising Star|2013]]. He has reached another two finals with the Reds in [[2016–17 Euroleague|2017]] and [[2022–23 EuroLeague|2023]]. He is also the first player in EuroLeague history to record 2.000 points, 1.000 rebounds, 400 assists, 300 three-pointers made, 200 steals and 100 blocks.{{Cite web |date=2022-11-10 |title=Κώστας Παπανικολάου: Ένα απίστευτο "milestone", μοναδικό στην ιστορία της Ευρωλίγκας! (pic) |url=https://www.eurohoops.net/el/euroleague-el-2/1416925/kostas-papanikolaou-ena-apistefto-milestone-monadiko-stin-istoria-tis-evroligkas-pic/ |access-date=2023-02-07 |website=Eurohoops |language=el}} Since very early in his career, Papanikolaou has been a regular member of the [[Greece national basketball team|Hellenic national team]]. After winning five medals at the youth level, he helped Greece capture the bronze medal at [[EuroBasket 2025]]. ==Professional career== ===Aris (2008–2009)=== Papanikolaou began playing basketball with the youth teams of Proteas Grevenon and Aris, and he made his pro debut in the [[Greek Basketball League|Greek League]], with [[Aris B.C.|Aris]], during the 2008–09 season. He was named the MVP of the [[HEBA Greek All-Star Game|Greek Youth All-Star Game]] in 2009. He was also named the Greek League's [[Greek Basketball League Best Young Player|Best Young Player]] in 2009.{{cite web|url=http://www.arisbc.gr/index.php?SCREEN=page&PageID=2111&LangID=2 |title=Best young player, Papanikolaou |work=ArisBC.gr |date=24 June 2009 |access-date=24 June 2009 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140809163300/http://www.arisbc.gr/index.php?SCREEN=page&PageID=2111&LangID=2 |archive-date=9 August 2014 }} ===Olympiacos (2009–2013)=== On 14 September 2009, Papanikolaou signed a five-year, €1.3 million [[net income]] deal with [[Olympiacos B.C.|Olympiacos]],{{cite web|url=http://www.euroleague.net/euroleaguenews/transactions/2009-10-signings/i/58160/3694/olympiacos-nabs-prospect-papanikolaou |title=OLYMPIACOS nabs prospect Papanikolaou |work=Euroleague.net |date=14 September 2009 |access-date=14 September 2009 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140809213046/http://www.euroleague.net/euroleaguenews/transactions/2009-10-signings/i/58160/3694/olympiacos-nabs-prospect-papanikolaou |archive-date=9 August 2014 }} after Olympiacos paid a €950,000 buyout fee to [[Aris B.C.|Aris]], to secure his player rights.{{cite web|url=http://www.redplanet.gr/basket/paei-sthn-mpartselona-o-papanikolaoy.2340225.html |script-title=el:Πάει στην Μπαρτσελόνα ο Παπανικολάου! |work=RedPlanet.gr |date=20 July 2013 |access-date=20 July 2013 |language=el |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140726043335/http://www.redplanet.gr/basket/paei-sthn-mpartselona-o-papanikolaoy.2340225.html |archive-date=26 July 2014 }} Papanikolaou's contract with Olympiacos had an [[National Basketball Association|NBA]] buyout clause worth €1 million.{{cite web|url=http://www.redplanet.gr/basket/papanikolaoy-o-kathenas-mporei-na-grafei-o-ti-thelei.2223408.html |script-title=el:Παπανικολάου: "Ο καθένας μπορεί να γράφει ό,τι θέλει" |work=RedPlanet.gr |date=22 April 2013 |access-date=22 April 2013 |language=el |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140810070743/http://www.redplanet.gr/basket/papanikolaoy-o-kathenas-mporei-na-grafei-o-ti-thelei.2223408.html |archive-date=10 August 2014 }} With Olympiacos, he won the [[EuroLeague]] and [[Greek Basket League|Greek League]] championships in 2012. Papanikolaou was voted the [[EuroLeague Rising Star]] for the [[2012–13 Euroleague|EuroLeague 2012–13 season]].{{cite web|title=Rising Star Trophy winner: Kostas Papanikolaou, Olympiacos Piraeus|url=http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/112909/180|work=Euroleague.net|date=1 May 2013|access-date=1 May 2013}} With Olympiacos, he also won the [[2012–13 Euroleague|2012–13 season]] EuroLeague championship. ===FC Barcelona (2013–2014)=== On 20 July 2013, Papanikolaou signed a four-year deal with [[Liga ACB|Spanish League]] club [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet|FC Barcelona]],{{cite web|url=http://www.euroleague.net/euroleaguenews/transactions/2013-14-signings/i/114958/8177 |title=FC BARCELONA lands Kostas Papanikolaou! |work=Euroleague.net |date=20 July 2013 |access-date=20 July 2013 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140726000350/http://www.euroleague.net/euroleaguenews/transactions/2013-14-signings/i/114958/8177 |archive-date=26 July 2014 }} after Barcelona bought Papanikolaou out of his contract with Olympiacos, paying a transfer buyout fee of €1.5 million to Olympiacos, and giving Papanikolaou a contract worth €5.5 million [[net income]], during the contract's first three years (the 4th optional year would be at an additional salary). The contract included NBA buyout clauses in the amounts of €1.1 million for 2014,{{cite web|url=http://www.eurohoops.net/2014/07/dribbling/52621 |title=Interest from Houston for "Pap", not offer yet |work=Eurohoops.net |date=15 July 2014 |access-date=15 July 2014 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140918112237/http://www.eurohoops.net/2014/07/dribbling/52621 |archive-date=18 September 2014 }} and €750,000 for 2015.{{cite web|url=http://www.sport24.gr/Basket/OmadesBasket/A1Olympiakos/paei-mpartselona-o-papanikolaoy.2340187.html|script-title=el:ΑΠΟΚΛΕΙΣΤΙΚΟ: Πάει Μπαρτσελόνα ο Παπανικολάου!|work=Sport24.gr|date=20 July 2013|access-date=20 July 2013|language=el}} Barcelona went on to win the 2013–14 Spanish Liga ACB championship. ===Houston Rockets (2014–2015)=== On 28 June 2012, Papanikolaou was selected with the 48th overall pick in the [[2012 NBA draft]] by the [[New York Knicks]]. On July 16, 2012, his draft rights were acquired by the [[Portland Trail Blazers]], via a trade that sent [[Raymond Felton]] to the Knicks.{{cite web|url=http://knicksnow.com/posts/1601/knicks-acquire-felton-thomas |title=Knicks Acquire Felton & Thomas |work=KnicksNow.com |date=16 July 2012 |access-date=16 July 2012 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140419012802/http://knicksnow.com/posts/1601/knicks-acquire-felton-thomas |archive-date=19 April 2014 }} On 10 July 2013, Papanikolaou's rights were acquired by the [[Houston Rockets]], via a trade that sent [[Thomas Robinson (basketball)|Thomas Robinson]] to the Trail Blazers.{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/rockets/news/rockets-acquire-papanikolaou-todorovic-and-two-future-2nd-round-picks|title=Rockets Acquire Papanikolaou, Todorovic and Two Future 2nd Round Picks|work=NBA.com|date=10 July 2013|access-date=10 July 2013}} On 23 September 2014, Papanikolaou signed with the Houston Rockets.{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/rockets/news/rockets-sign-kostas-papanikolaou|title=Rockets Sign Kostas Papanikolaou|work=NBA.com|date= 23 September 2014|access-date=23 September 2014}} On 13 February 2015, he took part in the [[Rising Stars Challenge]] of the [[2015 NBA All-Star Game|NBA All-Star Game]]; in spite of an injury-plagued rookie season, during which he averaged 4.2 points and 2.7 rebounds per game, while coming off the bench, the Rockets decided to pick up his team option for the 2015–16 season.{{cite news|title=Rockets pick up option on Kostas Papanikolaou|url=http://blog.chron.com/ultimaterockets/2015/06/rockets-pick-up-option-on-kostas-papanikolaou/|access-date=24 June 2015|work=blog.chron.com|date=24 June 2015}} ===Denver Nuggets (2015–2016)=== On 20 July 2015, the Rockets traded Papanikolaou, [[Joey Dorsey]], [[Nick Johnson (basketball)|Nick Johnson]], [[Pablo Prigioni]], a 2016 first-round draft pick, and cash considerations to the [[Denver Nuggets]], in exchange for [[Ty Lawson]] and a 2017 second-round draft pick.{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/nuggets/news/nuggets-acquire-joey-dorsey-nick-johnson-kostas-papanikolaou-pablo-prigioni-cash-considerations|title=Nuggets Acquire Joey Dorsey, Nick Johnson, Kostas Papanikolaou, Pablo Prigioni, Cash Considerations and First Round Pick From Houston|work=NBA.com|date=20 July 2015|access-date=20 July 2015}} On 25 September 2015, he was waived by the Nuggets.{{cite news|last=Stein|first=Marc|title=Sources: Kostas Papanikolaou, part of Ty Lawson deal, waived by Nuggets|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/13739740/denver-nuggets-waive-forward-kostas-papanikolaou|access-date=25 September 2015|work=ESPN.com|date=25 September 2015}} He later re-signed with Denver on November 5, 2015,{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/nuggets/news/nuggets-sign-kostas-papanikolaou|title=Nuggets Sign Kostas Papanikolaou|work=NBA.com|date=5 November 2015|access-date=5 November 2015}} and made his debut for the team that night.{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/games/20151105/UTADEN/gameinfo.html|title=Hayward scores 20, Jazz beat Nuggets 96-84|work=NBA.com|date=5 November 2015|access-date=5 November 2015}} He was waived again by the Nuggets on 7 January 2016, before his salary became fully guaranteed.{{cite web|last=Wojnarowski|first=Adrian|url=https://sports.yahoo.com/news/sources--nuggets-waive-forward-kostas-papanikolaou-180046493.html|title=Sources: Nuggets waive forward Kostas Papanikolaou|work=Yahoo.com|date=7 January 2016|access-date=8 January 2016}} ===Return to Olympiacos (2016–present)=== On 20 January 2016, Papanikolaou signed a two-and-a-half-year deal with [[Olympiacos B.C.|Olympiacos]], returning to the club for a second stint.{{cite web|title=Olympiacos officially announced Papanikolaou|url=http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/6mhe4csa88g5j87m/olympiacos-brings-back-two-time-champ-papanikolaou|work=Euroleague.net|date=20 January 2016|access-date=20 January 2016}} On 5 July 2018, Papanikolaou and Olympiacos officially agreed on a new three-year contract extension. He signed another three-year extension on 22 September 2020.{{cite news |title=Olympiacos signs Kostas Papanikolaou to contract extension |url=https://sportando.basketball/en/olympiacos-signs-kostas-papanikolaou-to-contract-extension/ |website=Sportando |access-date=September 22, 2020 |date=September 22, 2020 |last1=Carchia |first1=Emiliano }} On July 6, 2023, Papanikolaou renewed his contract with the Greek club through 2026. On July 10, 2026, he received a new two-year contract through the 2027-2028 season.{{cite web |title=Olympiacos extends captain Kostas Papanikolaou through 2028 |url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/euroleague/1990004/olympiacos-extends-captain-kostas-papanikolaou-through-2028/ |website=Eurohoops |access-date=28 July 2026 |language=en |date=10 July 2026}} ==National team career== ===Greek junior national=== As a member of the junior national basketball teams of Greece, Papanikolaou won the silver medal at the [[2007 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]] and the gold medal at the [[2008 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]]. He also won the silver medal at the [[2009 FIBA Under-19 World Championship|2009 FIBA Under-19 World Cup]]. Papanikolaou also won the gold medal at the [[2009 FIBA Europe Under-20 Championship]], where he was also named to the All-Tournament Team and won the MVP award.{{cite news|title=GOLDEN GREEKS CONQUER FRANCE|url=http://www.fibaeurope.com/cid_KNce8jInH7Qj1EsyH5rjn2.season_2009.compID_UIfgjyQcGqk-fPlnl66Tj0.coid_ZH86crphIo6i4jss456gs3.articleMode_on.html|access-date=26 July 2009|work=FIBAEurope.com|date=26 July 2009}} He then won the silver medal at the [[2010 FIBA Europe Under-20 Championship]] with Greece's junior national team, where he was also named to the All-Tournament Team.{{cite news|title=MVP ALBICY HEADLINES ALL TOURNAMENT TEAM|url=http://www.fibaeurope.com/cid_KNce8jInH7Qj1EsyH5rjn2.roundID_7339.compID_UIfgjyQcGqk-fPlnl66Tj0.season_2010.coid_N,JcameLInQJ0bZbC8GS61.articleMode_on.html|access-date=18 July 2010|work=FIBAEurope.com|date=18 July 2010}} ===Greek senior national team=== In August 2009, Papanikolaou made his debut with the senior men's [[Greece national basketball team|Greek national basketball team]], in a [[exhibition game|friendly game]]. With Greece's senior national team, he then played at [[EuroBasket 2011]], the [[2012 FIBA World Olympic Qualifying Tournament for Men|2012 FIBA World Olympic Qualifying Tournament]], the [[EuroBasket 2013]], the [[2014 FIBA World Cup]], the [[EuroBasket 2015]], the [[EuroBasket 2017]], the [[2019 FIBA World Cup]], and the [[EuroBasket 2022]]. He has appeared in 134 games for the senior national side and has scored a total of 842 points. ==Player profile== An off-ball player, Papanikolaou can play the positions 2-4 comfortably. He is considered to be an effective shooter from 3-point range, and also often attacks close-outs and finishes strong at the rim. On the other side of the ball, Papanikolaou is widely considered to be an defender,{{Cite web |date=2020-06-17 |title=Κώστας Παπανικολάου: Το αμυντικό "πολυεργαλείο" του Ολυμπιακού (video) |url=https://www.eurohoops.net/el/euroleague-el-2/1071363/kostas-papanikolaou-to-amintiko-poliergalio-tou-olimpiakou-video/ |access-date=2022-03-22 |website=Eurohoops |language=el}}{{Cite web |last=Πάλλας |first=Γιάννης |date=2021-11-05 |title=Όταν λέμε άμυνα, εννοούμε... Παπανικολάου! |url=https://www.onsports.gr/opinion/story/751723/otan-leme-amyna-ennoyme-papanikolaoy |access-date=2022-03-20 |website=Onsports.gr |language=el}}{{Cite web |last=thrylos24.gr |date=2020-04-17 |title=Μιλουτίνοφ: "Από τους κορυφαίους αμυντικούς στην Ευρώπη ο Παπανικολάου..." |url=https://www.thrylos24.gr/miloytinof-apo-toys-koryfaioys-amyntikoys-stin-eyropi-o-papanikolaoy/ |access-date=2022-03-23 |website=Thrylos24.gr |language=el}} he was the 2017 Greek League Best Defender, winning the same honor in the Spanish ACB League in the 2014 season. He has also been recognized as a leader, captaining Olympiacos to the [[EuroLeague Championship Game|Euroleague Championship Game]] in 2023 & 2026. ==Awards and accomplishments== === Club career ===
